annotations.title: Every one of the team's sites: its status right now, and the open incidents

description: Wraps GET /api/status. Every one of the team's sites: its status right now, and the open incidents. Call this first, or on a schedule (at most once a minute, as often as the checks run), to see whether anything is down or warning right now.
name: status

openIncidents.description: every open incident, newest first; /api/incidents has them in full

cause.description: what the check saw, in our words

dismissed.description: the team marked it as noise

kind.description: what kind of problem, as in /api/incidents

severity.description: down: an outage; warning: something to fix

site.description: the site's slug; null for a domain's incident

slug.description: the site's slug: its id in every /api/sites/{slug} route

status.description: its status now: "up", "down", "degraded" (up, with warnings open) or "unknown" (not checked yet)

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call
